agency-selection.label: Agency selection
agency-selection.buyerContext: SEO or growth at a B2B company choosing an accountable search partner
agency-selection.evidenceStandard: technical implementation ownership, named case-study evidence, pricing clarity, and qualified-demand measurement

ai-search-problems.label: AI-search problems
ai-search-problems.buyerContext: a company that is visible in traditional search but absent or inaccurate in generated answers
ai-search-problems.evidenceStandard: crawler access, indexed source pages, query fan-out, citations, factual accuracy, competitor inclusion, referrals, and conversions

seo-services.label: SEO services
seo-services.buyerContext: a team with a defined organic-search problem and limited internal implementation capacity
seo-services.evidenceStandard: page cohorts, technical dependencies, implementation owners, before-and-after validation, and business impact

platform-searches.label: Platform searches
platform-searches.buyerContext: a company whose CMS or commerce platform creates platform-specific crawling, rendering, template, and merchandising constraints
platform-searches.evidenceStandard: platform-specific technical knowledge, release workflows, revenue measurement, and relevant implementation evidence

industry-brand.label: Industry and brand evaluation
industry-brand.buyerContext: a buyer comparing specialist SEO partners for a high-consideration engagement
industry-brand.evidenceStandard: industry search journeys, site architecture, conversion model, public evidence, scope, limitations, and current pricing
